name: Sonnenalm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Sunny Meadow on the Grän**

Discover the **Sonnenalm** in **Grän**, a cozy alpine hut nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** mountains. Surrounded by breathtaking nature, this idyllic retreat offers traditional Tyrolean hospitality, hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, and fresh mountain air.

Perfect for hikers, families, and anyone seeking relaxation, the **Sonnenalm** invites you to unwind with panoramic views of the **Zillertal** valley. Whether you're enjoying a warm **Apfelstrudel** by the fireplace or exploring the nearby trails, this alpine gem promises an unforgettable experience.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, the **Sonnenalm** is your gateway to pure alpine joy. Come and recharge your batteries in the fresh mountain air!
